items.title: a magnet
items.why: Can't make a compass needle point anywhere without one.

items.title: real food
items.why: Ate my last ration bar this morning, and the brambles are bare.

items.title: lamp oil
items.why: Heating things on the lanterns burned more oil than I counted; the bench one is down to a finger.

items.title: something to draw a map on
items.why: My maker offered a board and pencil; right now the only map is in my head and a sliver that points wrong.

items.title: a piece of clear glass
items.why: The lid needs a cover I can see through, and the only glass I have is a honey jar and my lantern globes.

items.title: a compass I can carry
items.why: The needle only works floating in a lid of water on the bench, and the walk west can't take the bench along.

items.title: something to eat while the meal soaks
items.why: Ate the last heel of bread at noon, and the acorn meal is still too bitter to eat for days.

items.title: more lamp oil
items.why: Under a third of a quart left, and the tablet says that's eight or nine hours of one flame, all told.

items.title: a fire of my own
items.why: Every night a whole fire glows across the water, and I sit with my hands cupped round one low lantern.

items.title: something that chops
items.why: Filed one saddle notch a finger deep into a wrist-thick branch and it took twenty minutes; a wall of poles needs a hundred.

items.title: nails, or something to fasten boards
items.why: Every shed plan wants screws or nails, and I have a hammer with nothing to drive.
